description: Source code for certificate utility functions, including PEM parsing, certificate extraction, and SPKI hash calculation.

classes.name: SPKIHash
classes.description: Class representing a hash of Subject Public Key Info (SPKI).

methods.name: ParsePEM
methods.description: Parses a PEM-formatted string to extract the DER-encoded data of a specific block type.

methods.name: ExtractFieldFromX509Name
methods.description: Extracts a specific field from an X509_NAME object based on NID.

methods.name: GetX509CertificateFromPEM
methods.description: Converts PEM data into an X509 certificate object.

methods.name: ExtractSubjectNameFromCertificate
methods.description: Extracts the subject name from an X509 certificate, prioritizing common name, then organization and organizational unit.

methods.name: CalculateSPKIHashFromCertificate
methods.description: Calculates the SPKI hash from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: CalculateSPKIHashFromKey
methods.description: Calculates the SPKI hash from a PEM-encoded public key.
